description: This file implements an in-memory Server-Sent Events (SSE) manager class called SSEManager, which handles subscriber registration, deregistration, broadcasting messages, and streaming data to clients for real-time event updates.

classes.name: SSEManager
classes.description: A class that manages SSE subscriber queues, broadcasting, and streaming for event notifications.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the SSEManager with a default dictionary for subscribers and an asyncio lock.

methods.name: asyncio.Queue[str] subscribe(self, event_id: int)
methods.description: Registers a new subscriber for a specific event ID and returns an asyncio.Queue for message delivery.

methods.name: None unsubscribe(self, event_id: int, queue: asyncio.Queue[str])
methods.description: Removes a subscriber queue from the list associated with an event ID.

methods.name: None broadcast(self, event_id: int, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Sends a JSON-serialized data payload to all subscribers of a specified event ID.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[str,None] event_stream(self, event_id: int)
methods.description: An asynchronous generator that yields SSE-formatted data strings to a subscriber for a given event ID.

ctags.name: broadcast
ctags.pattern: /^    async def broadcast(self, event_id: int, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:$/

ctags.name: event_stream
ctags.pattern: /^    async def event_stream(self, event_id: int) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:$/

ctags.pattern: /^    async def subscribe(self, event_id: int) -> asyncio.Queue[str]:$/

ctags.pattern: /^    async def unsubscribe(self, event_id: int, queue: asyncio.Queue[str]) -> None:$/
